FICTIONAL SAMPLE PRESS RELEASE FOR TESTING

Northwind Foods to Acquire Harbor Snacks for $4.2 Billion

CHICAGO - Northwind Foods, Inc. ("Northwind") today announced a definitive agreement to acquire Harbor Snacks Holdings ("Harbor"), a maker of better-for-you salty snacks, from private equity firm Bayline Capital for $4.2 billion in cash, including the assumption of debt.

The purchase price represents approximately 14.5x Harbor's adjusted EBITDA of $290 million for the twelve months ended June 30, 2026. Harbor generated net sales of $1.6 billion over the same period, growing 11% year over year.

Northwind expects to realize $120 million of annual run-rate cost synergies by the end of the third year after closing, primarily from manufacturing and distribution. Including synergies, the transaction multiple is approximately 10.2x. Northwind expects the transaction to be accretive to adjusted earnings per share in the first full year after closing.

Northwind will fund the transaction with cash on hand and $3.5 billion of new committed debt financing. Northwind expects net leverage to be approximately 3.8x at closing and plans to reduce it to below 3.0x within 24 months.

"Harbor gives us a leading position in one of the fastest-growing parts of the snack aisle," said Northwind CEO Dana Whitfield.

The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals. Lakeview Partners is serving as financial advisor to Northwind; Crestmoor & Co. is serving as financial advisor to Harbor.

Pinecrest Software Agrees to Buy Tally Analytics in $780 Million Cash-and-Stock Deal

SAN FRANCISCO - Pinecrest Software Corp. today said it will acquire Tally Analytics, a privately held provider of retail pricing software, for $780 million. Tally shareholders will receive 60% of the consideration in cash and 40% in Pinecrest common stock.

Tally expects annual recurring revenue of $95 million in 2026, implying a multiple of approximately 8.2x ARR. Pinecrest expects the deal to be dilutive to non-GAAP earnings per share in 2027 and accretive in 2028.

The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. Granite Hill Advisors is acting as exclusive financial advisor to Pinecrest.
